Position Title: Success Coach
  

Candidate: TBD

Supervisor: Associate Director of Client Services

Salary Range: $32\.50

OUR IMPACT


For over 50 years, Samaritan House has been leading the fight against poverty in San Mateo County. We’re the
  

only organization that delivers the full breadth of essential services and personalized support to the working poor.
  

By ensuring our clients are fed, clothed, healthy, and housed, we help them create their own stability and remain
  

an active, successful part of our community. After all, an enduring community is only possible when every person
  

has the resources they need to live.  

  



OUR CULTURE
  

We’re passionate about providing our employees with a supportive work environment and experiences that help
  

them grow. We offer excellent opportunities for individuals with proven strong, creative, results\-driven leadership
  

skills and stellar work ethics. We welcome candidates who love working with people of diverse backgrounds and
  

want to make a difference by fostering community care for our neighbors in need.  

  



YOUR IMPACT
  

Under the general supervision of the Associate Director of Client Services, the Success Coach are responsible for
  

providing exemplary service to Samaritan House clients within our Client Services Department. Ideal candidates
  

are direct service social workers who will identify those in need; help people of all life stages with diverse
  

backgrounds cope with and solve everyday problems; advocate for and develop plans to improve clients’ well\-  

being; research and refer clients to community resources; respond to clients in crisis situations; and collaborate
  

and work effectively within a variety of diverse public and private organizations.
  

  

In addition to supporting clients in active crisis, Success Coach will also work with individuals and families who are
  

not currently experiencing a crisis but require more intensive, long\-term case management support. This includes
  

helping these clients prepare for stability and independence by developing and tracking individual goals and
  

objectives, identifying and addressing both personal strengths and challenges, and providing ongoing guidance,
  

support, and accountability throughout their journey toward self\-sufficiency.
  

  

Success Coach will maintain a caseload of approximately 20 clients at a time to ensure personalized and focused
  

support. The ideal candidate is flexible, detail\-oriented, compassionate, and able to function both independently
  

and collaboratively within a team. Success Coach will use a consistent and systematic set of practices to perform
  

the essential functions of the position.

Please note our preferred and in some cases required qualifications for this position:

 A Master’s degree in Social Work (MSW) is preferred.
  

 Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or a related field required. Equivalent work experience


may substitute in some instances.

Under direct supervision, serves as a primary support and case manager for individuals with mental illness and other co\-occurring disorders by assisting them to live as independently as possible in their chosen community. Case Manager III is distinguished from Case Manager II by the additional education, years of experience, and ability to proficiently perform the job functions and meet position standards.

  


**Shifts Available:**



Monday\- Friday 8:00am\-5:30pm



Expected starting wage range is $22\.62 \- $27\.63\.

  



Telecare applies geographic differentials to its pay ranges. The pay range assigned to this role will be based on the geographic location from which the role is performed. Starting pay is commensurate with relevant experience above the minimum requirements.

  


**What You Bring to the Table (Must Have)**


* Bachelor’s degree in Social Services or Human Services and (1\) year of experience or High School Graduation or G.E.D. equivalent and four (4\) years of direct services in Mental Health or community services; an Associate's degree may be substituted for two (2\) year of experience.

* Willingness to use your personal vehicle to drive clients to appointments and groups, etc. **(weekly mileage reimbursement at the IRS rate)**
* Willingness to use your personal vehicle to attend meetings, etc. **(weekly mileage reimbursement at the IRS rate)**

  


**What’s In It For You\***


* Paid Time Off: Eligible employees (20\+ hours/week) earn PTO each pay period for vacation and personal needs, with pro\-rated accrual for part\-time schedules and annual carryover up to set caps.

* Medical, Vision, Dental Insurance, 401K, Employee Stock Ownership Plan

jobs.title: Electrical Project Manager — High-End Residential Energize California | Palo Alto, CA
jobs.description:
Energize California is seeking an experienced Electrical Project Manager to lead high\-end residential electrical installations throughout Silicon Valley.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who can run projects from start to finish while regularly performing electrical installation work alongside the crew. You’ll direct up to 10 electricians and field staff, coordinate project documentation and permitting, oversee quality, and keep work progressing through inspections and completion.

You’ll report directly to the company Owner and work closely with our office to manage project costs and support accounts receivable. Daily reporting to and working from our office is required, along with regular work at project sites. This position does not offer remote work.

Responsibilities

* Manage assigned high\-end residential electrical projects from pre\-construction through installation, inspections, and closeout.
* Regularly perform electrical installation work alongside the crew.
* Direct crews of up to 10, assign work, communicate priorities, and monitor progress.
* Maintain high standards of workmanship, safety, and compliance with the California Electrical Code.
* Read, interpret, and mark up electrical drawings; navigate drawing packages, specifications, and product submittal sheets.
* Coordinate submittals, permit applications, inspections, and required project documentation.
* Plan schedules, crew assignments, and material needs to keep projects moving.
* Identify field conflicts, missing information, and installation issues; coordinate resolutions with the Owner and relevant project teams.
* Communicate with homeowners, general contractors, architects, designers, inspectors, and other stakeholders as needed, involving the Owner in key decisions.
* Work with the office to track project costs and provide accurate information for billing and accounts receivable.
* Maintain organized digital records, schedules, and project updates.
* Support solar PV and battery storage installations as needed, with training available.

Required Qualifications

* **At least five years of experience at the electrical project manager level.**
* **Hands\-on experience in high\-end residential electrical construction.**
* Demonstrated ability to manage electrical installations from start to finish while actively participating in fieldwork.
* Experience leading electrical crews and maintaining accountability for workmanship, productivity, and safety.
* Proven experience navigating permitting processes and coordinating inspections.
* Strong working knowledge of the California Electrical Code.
* Proficiency in reading and marking up electrical drawings and working with complete construction drawing packages.
* Strong computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, digital plan review and markup, scheduling software, and online permitting portals.
* Strong organization, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* A journeyman electrician credential, an electrical engineering qualification, or relevant construction management training. Accepted training includes a degree, recognized certificate, or documented employer\-led training.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to report to our Palo Alto office daily and travel to Silicon Valley project sites.

Preferred Qualifications

* A degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field. Candidates with a relevant degree will receive priority when they also meet the required experience and practical qualifications.
* Experience with PG\&E applications, utility paperwork, and coordination.
* Experience with solar PV and energy storage systems.
* Familiarity with Bluebeam, Procore, or comparable construction software.

Technical design and AutoCAD drafting are not part of this role. Solar PV, battery storage, and PG\&E\-specific processes can be developed on the job.

Compensation and Benefits

* Compensation based on experience.
* 401(k).
* Health insurance.
* Paid time off.
* Parental leave.
* Flexible scheduling coordinated around required office attendance and project needs.
* Professional development assistance.
* Company vehicle and phone provided as needed.
* Potential opportunity for profit sharing after establishing a strong track record with the company.

Growth Opportunities

As you demonstrate your ability to deliver projects successfully, the role may expand to managing multiple projects. There may also be opportunities to manage projects globally.

Schedule and Location

* Full\-time, Monday through Friday.
* Daily attendance at our Palo Alto office.
* Regular on\-site work throughout Silicon Valley.
* In\-person position; no remote work.

Pay: $50\.00 \- $75\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: In person

The Program Manager serves as the senior operational lead and primary customer contact for assigned accounts, overseeing deployment operations across a cross\-functional team, from order intake and readiness through production, delivery, and business review. The role provides end\-to\-end leadership across the delivery team, ensuring customer requirements are understood, commitments are actively managed, risks are addressed, and stakeholders have clear visibility into performance. We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Program Manager specializing in the automotive industry to lead complex, cross\-functional initiatives from conception through execution. This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive innovation, optimize processes, and deliver impactful results within a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment. As a Program Manager, you will oversee multiple projects, coordinate teams, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives. Your leadership will be instrumental in advancing automotive product development, process improvements, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.

Responsibilities

* Lead the planning, development, and execution of automotive programs by defining scope, objectives, and deliverables aligned with organizational goals.
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration among engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality assurance, and other key departments to ensure seamless program delivery.
* Implement Agile methodologies such as Scrum and SAFe to enhance project flexibility and responsiveness; utilize tools like Jira and Confluence for tracking progress.
* Conduct root cause analysis and apply Lean Six Sigma principles to identify inefficiencies and implement process improvements that drive quality and cost savings.
* Manage project schedules using tools like Primavera P6 or Project Server; monitor progress through earned value management to ensure timely delivery within budget constraints.
* Oversee risk management activities by identifying potential issues early and developing mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project timelines.
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels through presentations, reports, and meetings; facilitate conflict resolution and negotiate priorities when necessary.

Skills

* Extensive experience in program development, project management lifecycle, and program design within the automotive or related industries.
* Proficiency in project management methodologies including Waterfall, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Lean, and PMBOK standards; familiar with PPM tools such as Workday, Trello, Basecamp or VersionOne.
* Strong leadership capabilities with supervising experience in technical project teams; demonstrated success in team management and team leadership roles.
* Expertise in requirements gathering, requirements analysis, process mapping, business process modeling, and scope management to ensure clarity and alignment across projects.
* Skilled in data analysis using Excel or SAS for data collection and reporting; adept at vendor management and contract negotiations.
* Knowledge of IT infrastructure projects related to automotive systems; experience with project scheduling software like Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to facilitate meetings effectively while managing multiple stakeholders’ expectations.
* Certifications such as Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt), PMP or PgMP are highly desirable; familiarity with SAFe frameworks is a plus.

Join us to lead transformative automotive programs that shape the future of mobility! Your expertise will help us innovate faster, improve quality continuously, and deliver exceptional value across our projects—making a real impact on the industry’s evolution.

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr. Infrastructure Capacity Program Manager, NPI
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025\. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
**What You'll Do**
------------------



We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr. Infrastructure Capacity Program Manager, NPI to join our Infrastructure Capacity team. In this role, you will be the go\-to infrastructure capacity partner for our Hardware New Product Introduction (NPI) and Engineering Operations teams — tracking data center infrastructure hardware roadmaps, determining ordering cut\-over points, and signaling scope and BOM requirements to Capacity, Supply Chain, Construction, and Execution so that new hardware programs land in the fleet on schedule and old hardware is retired cleanly.


**About the role**
------------------


***Core Responsibilities***


* **NPI Roadmap:** Track infrastructure hardware NPI roadmaps and transition schedules across power, cooling, and network, giving Infrastructure Capacity forward visibility into what's coming online and what's being retired.
* **Cut\-Over Point Determination:** Determine the cut\-over point between ordering legacy/outgoing hardware and new/incoming hardware for each site or program — weighing lead times, EOL risk, and deployment timing to avoid over\-ordering hardware that's about to be replaced or under\-ordering ahead of a delayed transition.
* **Downstream Signaling (Scope \& BOM):** Signal downstream teams — Capacity, Supply Chain, Construction, and the Execution team — with clear scope and Bill of Materials (BOM) requirements as new hardware programs take shape, so each team can plan, budget, and procure in lockstep rather than reacting late.
* **NPI Weekly Meeting Representation:** Attend NPI weekly DC planning meetings as the standing representative of the Infrastructure Capacity team — bringing a capacity and infrastructure\-readiness lens into hardware planning discussions, and carrying decisions, risks, and action items back to Infrastructure Capacity and affected downstream teams.
* **Infrastructure Readiness PM \& Ownership:** Act as the program manager for infrastructure readiness on NPI hardware programs — driving cross\-functional workstreams, tracking milestones and risks, and ensuring power, cooling, network, and space readiness are in place ahead of each program's target ship/deployment date.


***Additional Responsibilities***


* **Infrastructure DC NPI / Product Scaling Designs:** Partner with Hardware NPI teams to translate new GPU/CPU, power, and cooling product designs into data center infrastructure requirements at scale — assessing whether existing site designs (power density, cooling architecture, rack/row layout) can support a new product generation, and defining the infrastructure scaling design changes needed where they cannot.
* **Cooling \& Power Architecture Transition Planning:** Apply working technical knowledge of cooling and power infrastructure to plan for major architecture transitions as new hardware programs mature — for example, moves from air\-cooled (AC) racks to in\-rack Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) to fully remote/centralized CDU plants — translating each transition into concrete power, space, and facility impacts for Design, Capacity, Supply Chain, and Construction.
* **Rack \& Network Hardware Program Support:** Provide infrastructure\-readiness planning for new rack\-level power/cooling control hardware (e.g., rack\-level power and cooling controller/monitoring modules and liquid\-cooling valve and manifold assemblies) and new high\-density, liquid\-cooled networking/switch rack designs, ensuring power, cooling, space, and cabling\-pathway readiness keeps pace with these programs from early prototype/pilot stages through fleet\-wide rollout.
* **Vendor \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Hardware NPI teams, equipment OEMs, DC Design and Network Engineering, Supply Chain, and Construction to align NPI timelines with site plans, procurement lead times, and CapEx/OpEx budgeting.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of NPI roadmaps, EOL schedules, cut\-over decisions, scope/BOM handoffs, and lifecycle\-management decisions, ensuring a clear system of record as hardware generations turn over.
* **Problem Solving:** Identify and resolve complex planning challenges where new hardware requirements outpace existing site capabilities, or where cut\-over timing is at risk, escalating trade\-offs that affect delivery timelines.
* **Industry Trends:** Stay abreast of emerging compute, power, cooling, and network hardware roadmaps and industry NPI/lifecycle\-management best practices, incorporating relevant advancements into CoreWeave's own NPI planning process.

**Who You Are**
---------------


* Data center infrastructure technical knowledge to understand and engage credibly in discussions about the products involved — GPUs, CPUs, Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), power hardware chain, and cooling infrastructure — without needing to design the hardware yourself.
* Strong program/project management skills: able to drive cross\-functional workstreams, track milestones and risks, hold multiple teams accountable to dates, and keep several concurrent NPI programs moving in parallel.
* Ideally, experience in cloud hardware or data center infrastructure; at minimum, a demonstrated ability to quickly learn power, cooling, and network hardware concepts well enough to represent Infrastructure Capacity in technical planning discussions.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Livermore


220417\-en\_US
  

  

**About the role**
The Senior Project Manager leads customer deployment projects from initiation through delivery and closure. Depending on the size and structure of the engagement, the Senior Project Manager may serve as the primary customer contact or work under the direction of a Program Manager who owns the broader customer relationship. In either model, the Senior Project Manager owns project\-level planning, fulfillment oversight, shipping readiness, risk and issue management, stakeholder communication, and confirmation of successful delivery. Working across customers, Sales, engineering, production and integration, logistics, and other delivery functions, the Senior Project Manager establishes project direction, drives accountability, and ensures customer commitments are understood and actively managed. The role has no direct reports but leads cross\-functional project teams through influence, sound judgment, and disciplined execution. Success requires a strong service orientation, high professionalism, proactive communication, and the ability to manage multiple customer deployments with competing priorities and dependencies.


**What you'll be doing**


Customer and Project Leadership


* Lead assigned projects from initiation through delivery and closure, maintaining alignment on scope, schedule, priorities, responsibilities, and outcomes.
* Serve as the primary customer contact or, when a Program Manager owns the broader relationship, lead project\-level communication and delivery in alignment with that role.
* Build customer trust through professionalism, responsiveness, transparency, and consistent follow\-through.
* Lead cross\-functional teams through influence, setting priorities and driving accountability without direct reporting authority.

Fulfillment Planning and Readiness


* Monitor open orders and manage schedule requirements, fulfillment requests, priorities, and delivery commitments received from Sales and Professional Services.
* Maintain integrated plans covering technical design approval, production, shipping, delivery, resources, dependencies, and customer readiness.
* Confirm international compliance readiness with Sales before applicable orders advance.
* Ensure order documentation, technical approvals, production requirements, logistics details, and site readiness are complete and aligned to required dates.

Production, Shipping, and Delivery Oversight


* Coordinate production timelines, build requests and supporting documentation
* Partner with production planning teams to monitor progress and resolve schedule, capacity, quality, and readiness issues.
* Confirm production and shipping requirements are satisfied before release, escalating material risks with clear impacts and recommended actions.
* Monitor shipments through delivery, provide tracking and logistics updates to Professional Services and customers, and confirm onsite receipt before completion.

Project Controls and Communication


* Monitor performance against scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer commitments.
* Maintain accurate project, order, production, shipment, risk, issue, and decision information in designated systems.
* Provide customers, account teams, Program Managers, and delivery leadership with clear status, risk, milestone, and action reporting.
* Assess changes in scope or priority and communicate impacts to timing, cost, resources, dependencies, and customer expectations.

Closure and Continuous Improvement


* Validate completion of project requirements, obtain customer acceptance, and complete required documentation, financial, and closure activities.
* Lead project health checks, recovery efforts, and lessons\-learned reviews as appropriate.
* Drive practical improvements to delivery processes, controls, reporting, and cross\-functional ways of working.

**What you have**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* 7\+ years of project management experience, preferably within data centers, IT infrastructure, technology deployment, or professional services.
* Demonstrated success managing complex, concurrent projects and leading cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Project management certification, such as PMP, preferred
* Legally eligible to work in the United States.
* Strong service orientation and commitment to responsiveness, quality, accountability, and customer outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment, and hold cross\-functional stakeholders accountable.
* High professionalism, business judgment, and credibility in customer and leadership interactions.
* Strong project planning, financial management, fulfillment oversight, risk management, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to oversee multiple projects, orders, delivery timelines, and dependencies simultaneously.
* Ability to anticipate risks, assess business and customer impacts, and drive timely resolution.
* Working knowledge of technology deployment, design, configuration, production, integration, logistics, and service\-delivery practices.
* Proficiency with enterprise project, order, configuration, and deployment\-management systems.
* Ability to establish practical, repeatable project controls and drive consistent adoption across teams.
* Ability to travel based on customer and business needs.

----------------------------


### **Freedom \& trust**


You’ll have the support on hand when you need it and the autonomy when you don’t. Feel right at home in an environment where you’re able to work with freedom and flexibility, and trusted to manage your own work.


### **Showing appreciation \& having fun**

Under general direction, the Fatherhood Program Manager leads the planning, coordination, and administration of the Alameda County Fatherhood, a collaborative initiative that promotes and advocates for father\-friendly services and supports fathers and father figures in being meaningfully engaged with their children and families. Working collaboratively with internal and external partners, the position supports program implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement to advance the goals and impact of the Fatherhood program. The position also provides guidance and coordination to program consultants and the Fatherhood program members but does not exercise direct supervision of staff.




* Plans, coordinates, and leads trainings and learning communities in collaboration with the agency's training team
* Coordinates activities which further the integration and alignment of the Father\-Friendly Principles ad programming with other agency initiatives

Additional relevant work experience may be substituted to meet the college coursework/bachelor's degree standard.

* Best practices in father engagement strategies and practices
* System barriers that prevent fathers from engaging with their children or utilizing services
* Challenges fathers experience as parents
* Program planning, evaluation and quality assurance methodologies

**Job Summary**

Uses skills as a seasoned and experienced administrative operations professional to manage, plan, and administer operational and facilities functions for the Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI), spanning several locations. Provides day\-to\-day operational coordination for CNEI, ensuring consistent standards, procedures, and working conditions across multiple CNEI locations. Demonstrates good judgment in independently coordinating operational and administrative processes and prioritizing multi\-site logistics.


**Department Overview**

The Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI) is a support department with five main divisions: Nursing Professional Development, Nursing Quality and Analytics, Clinical Practice, Nursing Continuous Improvement and Research, and Magnet Recognition Program®. The Professional Development team includes Nursing Professional Development Specialists who oversee the Department of Nursing’s training and education needs. jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Applies extensive knowledge of ambulatory care clinics clinical, regulatory, and operational practices to improve access efficiency and productivity. Coordinates and monitors operations of ambulatory care clinics in conjunction with Nurse Manager and Medical Directors. Implements projects of large scope and high degrees of complexity. The Clinical Operations Specialist analyzes and determines clinical coverage needs of Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion Hospital Operating Rooms, the Orthopedic Institute, and all off\-site Anesthesia sites, in both operating and non\-operating locations. This individual then analyzes staffing availability data and develops staffing of more than 298 Anesthesiologists. This requires coordination with individuals charged with CRNA and clinical residents.
The Clinical Operations Specialist analyzes and determines clinical coverage needs of Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion Hospital Operating Rooms, the Orthopedic Institute, and all off\-site Anesthesia sites, in both operating and non\-operating locations. This individual then analyzes staffing availability data and develops staffing of more than 298 Anesthesiologists. This requires coordination with individuals charged with CRNA and clinical residents. This position must ensure appropriate coverage is provided for several specialty services, in addition to the operating rooms. Any staffing deficiencies or inappropriate coverage may pose risks to patient safety and affect the department’s operating costs. The position is responsible for identifying, analyzing and resolving staffing conflicts; moreover, the Clinical Operations Specialist is responsible for providing notice to principals (faculty, managers and staff) regarding amendments and modifications. The Clinial Operations Specialist must ensure the faculty are scheduled accordingly to their clinical requirements as established by their annual contracts. This has direct impact to the individual’s clinical incentive compensation and the Department’s operating costs.
  

  

The Clinical Operations Specialist assesses, identifies, and implements process improvements and AI or other automation opportunities for the clinical operations workflows within their scope of work. This may include, but is not limited to, new technology solutions and the creation and implementation of AI and machine learning\-enabled care workflows, in partnership and close collaboration with clinical and administrative professionals within the Anesthesia Department and across other parts of the UCSF enterprise.
  

  

The Clinical Operations Specialist will report directly to the Director of Clinical Operations with close working partnerships with the Vice Chairs of the Department of Anesthesia.
**Department Description:**The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care at UCSF provides outstanding patient care, promotes cutting\-edge basic and clinical science research, and educates the next generation of health care providers while focusing on the principles of community.
  

  

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine with an annual budget of $145 million. The two largest components of the annual budget are Professional Fee Income and Extramural Funds, representing 90\.4% or $132 million (including ZSFG professional fees and 6\.9% or $10\.1 million of the annual budget respectively. Currently, the department has over 298 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 205 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 12 Non\-Faculty Academics, 11 postdocs, 68 CRNAs, and 5 Nurse Practitioners at ZSFG.
  

  

In addition to the Moffitt\-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (inpatient and outpatient, including a very active trauma service), San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient), Mt. Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23\-hour stays and the Pain Management Center), Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland, the UCSF Orthopedic Institute and the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH\-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals in the Mission Bay neighborhood.
  

  

The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Over the department’s fifty\-plus years of existence, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day, continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care quickly earned and maintained reputations that are equal to or better than any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, FDA, and Editorial Boards. Research activities within this department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments for NIH research funding in anesthesia in the United States.
  

  

The Department of Anesthesia provides considerable support and structure for research in general and, for research training programs, highlighted by the innovative Pathway to Scientific Independence (PSI). This program begins at the residency level, incorporating the Research Scholars Track of the Anesthesia Residency, moving through the post\-residency NIH\-funded T32 training grant and faculty positions with mentored research support, and ultimately achieving extramurally funded, independent researcher status.

**Managing Director / Platform President – Large Animal Specialty \& Emergency Veterinary Network**

**Overview**

A private equity\-backed veterinary healthcare platform is seeking an experienced veterinary executive to lead the buildout, acquisition, and operational oversight of a national network of large animal specialty and emergency hospitals. The Managing Director / Platform President will be responsible for identifying acquisition opportunities, developing new greenfield hospital locations, integrating acquired practices, and building a scalable multi\-site veterinary platform. The platform is expected to scale to 7–10 facilities ranging from $15M–$50M in revenue per location, with 10,000\+ square foot specialty hospital footprints, targeting $250M\+ revenue growth over the next several years. This role requires a licensed veterinarian with meaningful operational leadership experience and direct involvement in veterinary practice M\&A, de novo site development, and multi\-location hospital management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Development \& M\&A**

* Identify and evaluate acquisition targets including specialty and emergency large animal hospitals across strategic markets
* Lead sourcing, diligence, and integration of veterinary practice acquisitions in partnership with private equity investment teams
* Develop greenfield opportunities, including market selection, site development, hospital design, and launch planning
* Build a scalable regional and national veterinary hospital platform through acquisitions and organic development
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations across a growing network of specialty veterinary hospitals
* Recruit, develop, and retain clinical leadership including veterinary specialists and hospital administrators

**Platform Integration \& Growth**

* Lead post\-acquisition integration including operational alignment, systems implementation, and cultural integration
* Standardize infrastructure including clinical protocols, technology systems, purchasing programs, and reporting frameworks
* Develop scalable operational playbooks to support continued expansion of the platform

**Financial \& Strategic Oversight**

* Manage P\&L performance across multiple hospitals and support annual budgeting and strategic planning
* Partner with private equity sponsors to execute long\-term growth strategy and value creation initiatives
* Monitor financial performance, operational KPIs, and growth metrics across the network

**Industry Leadership**

* Build relationships with veterinary specialists, referral networks, and industry partners
* Represent the platform within the veterinary specialty and emergency medicine community
* Help shape the long\-term strategic vision for the platform’s national expansion

**Qualifications**

* Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM or equivalent) required
* Active veterinary license in good standing
* 10\+ years of veterinary clinical and operational leadership experience
* Demonstrated experience participating in veterinary practice acquisitions or de novo hospital development
* Experience managing multi\-site veterinary hospitals or specialty veterinary practices
* Strong financial and operational acumen, including familiarity with hospital P\&L management
* Experience working with private equity, corporate veterinary groups, or multi\-location veterinary platforms strongly preferred
* Proven ability to recruit and lead veterinary specialists and hospital leadership teams

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines clinical credibility as a veterinarian with executive\-level operational leadership and M\&A experience. * Refer patients to pharmacists for medication\-related queries and guidance.

**Why WarriorBabe?**  

  

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

  

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one\-on\-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

 **Our Mission**  

  

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin

 **About the role**  

  

WarriorBabe is looking for a high\-energy, customer focused, and dedicated Client Success Coordinator to join our team! Our ideal candidate is someone who has knowledge of the WarriorBabe products, specifically the WarriorBabe VIP Program, and is passionate about helping women of all ages begin and continue their fitness journeys.

  

As a Customer Success Coordinator, you will be the driving force behind our customers' triumphs. Your deep knowledge of our transformative products, especially the acclaimed WarriorBabe VIP Program, will enable you to guide and inspire women at every step. This role is pivotal in building strong connections with both new and established customers, making it one of the most crucial touch points in our organization.

  

Beyond onboarding, this role plays an important part in the client journey by helping women stay engaged, connected, and committed to their goals. The Client Success Coordinator serves as a bridge between onboarding, coaching, and long\-term client success, helping identify opportunities for clients to maximize their experience with WarriorBabe through program renewals, ascension opportunities, and continued participation in our ecosystem.

 **What you'll do**  

  

Reporting to the Customer Success Manager, the Customer Success Coordinator at WarriorBabe is an employee who works directly with the WarriorBabe Leadership Team and is the primary point of contact for each new VIP client after the sales process. Clients are at the height of their motivation when they begin the onboarding process so consistently delivering a client\-centric experience is crucial. This is a role that is heavily\-focused on greeting new clients and answering questions in a timely and accurate way. Performance in this role is based on client satisfaction, onboarding velocity, responsiveness, product knowledge, client retention, and contribution to renewal and ascension opportunities. Success in this role requires building strong relationships with clients, helping them stay engaged throughout their journey, and identifying opportunities to connect them with the next best step in their WarriorBabe experience.

  

In summary, the WarriorBabe Client Success Coordinator is expected to:

* Support coach\-client assignments as part of the welcome call cadence for all new VIP clients with oversight from the Customer Success Manager
* Field general how\-to questions about the program and onboarding requirements post\-sale (received via email, phone, and text messages, primarily)
* Work closely with the internal WarriorBabe team to support any client issues and escalations.

Founded in 1947 and headquartered in Schofield, Wisconsin, Wausau Supply Company has a history of providing top\-quality building materials to authorized retailers across the United States. In addition to our distribution capabilities, Wausau Supply Company is known for its high\-quality manufactured brands, including Diamond Kote Siding System, Waudena, ChamClad and Taylor Entrance Systems. Kemira is a global leader in sustainable chemistry for water\-intensive industries. For more than 100 years, our chemistry has advanced human progress and quality of life. Water Solutions offers a wide range of innovative solutions to optimize all stages of the water treatment process while safely achieving water quality targets and meeting constantly tightening regulations. The business serves both municipal and industrial customers globally, with strong growth ambitions in the North American industrial market.
  
  

This position can be remote, but proximity to a major airport is a plus.

jobs.title: Health Coach - Remote
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**


Sharecare is a digital healthcare company that delivers software and tech\-enabled services to stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to help improve care quality, drive better outcomes, and lower costs. Through its data\-driven AI insights, evidence\-based resources, and comprehensive platform – including benefits navigation, care management, home care resources, health information management, and more – Sharecare helps people easily and efficiently manage their healthcare and improve their well\-being. Across its three business channels, Sharecare enables health plan sponsors, health systems and physician practices, and leading pharmaceutical brands to drive personalized and value\-based care at scale. To learn more, visit www.sharecare.com.


Health Coaches operate in a structured, high\-engagement outreach model utilizing an automated dialer system to connect with members throughout the day. Coaches conduct back\-to\-back coaching conversations, providing education, support, and motivation to help members progress toward their health goals while following established workflows and documentation standards.  

  

**Job Summary:**

**Start Date:** Monday, October 26th, 2026

**Shift:** Monday \- Friday: Must be open to any shift between the hours of 10:30am – 9:00pm CST.


It is required to work every fourth Saturday from 8:00am\-4:30pm CST

**Training:** Training will be a duration of 6 weeks from 8am – 4:30pm CST

* ***Due to the structured training schedule, new hires are unable to miss any days of training.***

**Compensation:** Hourly Rate: $21\.50 or $25 including certification through NBC\-HWC or CHES only


The Health Coach is part of a multi\-disciplinary team that is responsible for improving both the individual health and wellness of program participants and the overall health status of a client's population. The Health Coach is an integral part of an overall client specific Health and Care Support Team that engages and supports members with improving lifestyles and behaviors that put them "at risk" of developing chronic or disease conditions. The Health Coach looks to be a positive change agent in helping members alter behaviors that lead to better health and reduction / elimination of identified risk factors. A Health Coach is supervised by an Operations Coach Manager.

**Essential Job Functions:**


Participating in the following types of telephonic calls:

* Engagement (inbound and outbound)\- contacting eligible participants to inform them of the program offering and enroll them in the program
* Coaching (inbound and outbound)\- providing individualized behavior change coaching to reduce or eliminate high risk behaviors and encourage adoption of habits that are conducive to a higher quality of life
* Chase (outbound)\- reaching out to members who are enrolled in coaching, but do not have a scheduled call
* Coordinate delivery of services and care with other members of a multi\-disciplinary care team, including nurses, pharmacists and external vendors.
* Support operational aspects of the assigned area to meet the organization's customer requirements, which can include multiple customers.
* Adhere to a schedule and caseload to support success and connectivity of member interaction.
* Caseloads may be a 1:1 model or team based. This is determined by the business/client need.
* Participate in daily and monthly meetings for updates and to present findings and insight
* Note and track the members' progress and efficacy of program

**Specific Skills/ Attributes:**

* Effective interpersonal and communication skills required
* Understand directions and communicate/respond to inquiries
* Enthusiastically inspires members to change behaviors and to see possibilities
* Ability to learn to coach effectively using motivational interviewing
* Flexibility to work any shift (typically an evening shift) or change shifts based on business needs. This also includes availability to work rotating Saturdays

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in health\-related field required (i.e., Psychology, Nutrition, Exercise Science, etc.) In specific cases, NBHWC certification might substitute for the “health \-related” part of the completed 4\-year degree
* 1 \-2 years of related experience required; experience in a customer service role preferred
* Experience with benchmarks and contact center metrics preferred, including adherence to schedule
* Proficiency in computer data entry and Microsoft Office
* Ability to coordinate telephonic communication with program participants while simultaneously navigating software platform and entering data, for extended periods of time
* Knowledge ability to quickly learn information around lifestyle related topics such as: smoking cessation, weight management, nutrition, exercise, stress reduction and sleep desired
* Ability to work independently and prioritize a moderate workload with minimal supervision
* Adaptability to schedule changes on an as\-need basis
* Ability to multitask with members and operationally with managers and support staff
* Hard\-wired internet connection is necessary as WIFI is not permitted


Sharecare and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and E\-Verify users. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, equal pay, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or other status protected under applicable law.

jobs.description:
Significance, Inc is seeking a Senior Management Business Analyst to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This position will be remote.

The U.S. Department of Labor keeps its books in the New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS), an Oracle E\-Business Suite platform used by about 1,600 people to move roughly $70 billion a year. You will be the senior functional link between DOL accountants and the people who build and fix the system. You will own requirements, testing, and the hardest production problems in Federal Financials. When the general ledger does not tie out at year\-end, that lands with you.

Objective: keep NCFMS functionally correct and audit\-ready, so that DOL's accounting operations close on time and every configuration, interface, and enhancement change holds up under Treasury, OMB, GAO, and financial statement audit scrutiny.
### **Required Skills:**


Minimum 9 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or ERP business systems analyst supporting enterprise financial management systems. Federal financial systems experience strongly preferred within that total.  

* Minimum 5 of those 9 years hands\-on functional experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Federal Financials in one or more of: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Sub Ledger Accounting, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, and Oracle Projects.
* Functional business process analysis for a federal ERP system, spanning each aspect of both traditional and Agile SDLCs \- requirements through design, test, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Demonstrated experience eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements; authoring functional design documents, use cases, and process flows; maintaining requirements traceability; and validating that requirements were correctly implemented.
* Test planning and execution: developing test scenarios, scripts, and traceability matrices; executing unit, system, integration, regression, and User Acceptance Testing; documenting results and driving defects to closure.
* Production support and complex issue resolution: triaging user\-reported issues, root\-cause analysis, researching transaction and posting\-logic errors, and coordinating resolution with technical, DBA, and security teams \- including Tier 2 and Tier 3 functional support.
* Authoring senior\-level analytical deliverables: analysis papers, analyses of alternatives, decision papers, and other project deliverables for Government review.
* Performing quality assurance and oversight of functional work products \- peer review of requirements, design, and test artifacts.
* Working knowledge of federal financial management compliance drivers: U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL), Treasury Financial Manual, FASAB standards, OMB circulars, GAO guidance, budget execution and funds control, and the Anti\-Deficiency Act.
* Experience with structured change control and Change Control Board processes.
* Experience managing assigned work in an industry\-standard issue and backlog management tool
* Ability to perform with limited supervision and to provide direction, review, or mentoring to less senior analysts
### **Desired Skills:**

* Prior experience supporting federal Core Financial System with Oracle Federal Financials at a CFO Act agency
* Experience with end\-to\-end business processes: Procure\-to\-Pay, Bill\-to\-Collect, Acquire\-to\-Dispose, Request\-to\-Procure, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, Grants Management, Unemployment Trust Fund, Travel Management, General Ledger Integrity, and Working Capital Fund cost allocation using Oracle Projects.
* Experience with Treasury G\-Invoicing, including 7600A Interagency Agreements and 7600B Orders; GTAS; DATA Act reporting; and the Treasury Report on Receivables.
* Experience with applications and interfaces such as: Tungsten MarkView / Capture invoice imaging and workflow, Oracle Analytics Server reporting, Invoice Processing Platform, SAM vendor data, ETS2 travel, HHS GrantSolutions, NFC payroll, the AMS real\-time requisition and award interface, and the Citibank Purchase Card interface.
* Experience supporting federal financial statement audits — researching transactions, preparing audit responses and supporting documentation, and remediating findings through corrective action plans.
* Experience writing knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, quick reference guides, and user job aids.
* Experience as a task lead or supervising junior functional analysts on a federal ERP O\&M engagement.

jobs.title: Operations Associate, Beckett
jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

  

  

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

  

  

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

  

  

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on\-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.  



  

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.  



  

Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value\-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault and sell millions of record\-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible coins, trading cards, Funko Pops!, video games, event tickets, autographs, and memorabilia. We’re looking for an Operations Associate for our Beckett team to handle various processes across our trading card grading operations: order receiving, imaging, encapsulation, research \& ID, and quality control. This is an exciting opportunity to be one of our first employees in a brand new office space and join a team that is growing quickly. **You’ll report to the Operations Supervisor and work from our newest office in the Southwest Portland, OR suburbs Monday through Friday (exact shift time TBD, but will likely start between 6\-9am).** Experience as a collector or knowledge of trading cards in general is not required, but for those passionate about the hobby, this is a great opportunity to build a career in trading cards.


**What You’ll Do:**

* Match, count, and check items.
* Enter item information into the database and print stickers containing order details.
* Work with the Customer Service and Problem Orders departments to resolve problems.
* Work with other cross\-functional teams on special projects and/or deals.
* Research cards utilizing checklists from manufacturers and enter the information into our database
* Encapsulate and seal cards.
* Inspect assembled parts and product for defects and deviations.
* Verify information such as submission form details, product quantity, identification stickers, and labels.
* Verify order correctness and completeness.
* Take high resolution photos of each card in an order as they are completed, utilizing a mounted camera and computer program.
* Package orders in mailing box containers, seal with tape and attach outside labels.

* Safely handle and account for valuable merchandise, ensuring its security and proper handling throughout all process stages.

**Who You Are:**

* You have the ability to work in a team environment.
* You can prioritize all tasks and work in a fast\-paced work environment.

* You are professional in your behavior, interact respectfully with coworkers, and work well under pressure in fast\-paced environments.
* You produce high quality, accurate work and demonstrate thoroughness in your work.
* You are dependable and able to follow instructions and respond to directions from your supervisor(s).
* You have experience working with computers e.g. Gmail, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.
* You have great communication skills.
* You can make independent and knowledgeable decisions relating to the assigned task(s).
* You have good hand\-eye coordination and are comfortable with physical labor.
* Previous experience in a warehouse or manufacturing environment is a plus.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Bending and Twisting: Bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, and squatting.
* Computer Use: Typing, mouse work, and sitting and looking at a computer potentially for long periods of time.
* Hand Use: Regular hand use for various tasks.
* Hearing Requirements: Ability to hear alarms, signals, and verbal instructions.
* Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, and move materials up 50 lbs.
* Receiving and Inspecting Submissions: Ability to receive, and in some departments inspect, submissions. Ability to use a sharp blade and retrieve submissions from packaging.
* Sitting or Standing: Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time.

jobs.description:
**Apply on Indeed or via our website:** https://www.marketveep.com/careers/fractional\-onboarding\-specialists

\* This is a fractional (part\-time) role. Hours are not guaranteed.

\-\-

Guide clients through HubSpot onboarding, set up their systems strategically, and ensure smooth project execution. Here’s what you’ll focus on:

* **HubSpot Onboarding Consultation**: Lead clients through the HubSpot onboarding process, guiding them step by step to ensure a smooth and efficient implementation of Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and/or Service Hub.
* **Client HubSpot Training**: Host meetings to provide hands\-on training, share best practices, and give setup advice so clients can confidently use HubSpot for their business goals.
* **Project Management**: Ensure onboarding projects stay on schedule, within scope, and aligned with client expectations, coordinating closely with the production team for timely execution.
* **Client Satisfaction**: Monitor client progress and feedback throughout onboarding, proactively address concerns, and ensure deliverables meet standards—generating positive client reviews, testimonials, and overall satisfaction.

\-\-

**Your Professional Experience:**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with HubSpot, including Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and/or Service Hub, with the ability to guide clients through setup and best practices.
* 2\+ years of agency experience
* Experience in client onboarding, customer success, or account management, preferably with SaaS or CRM platforms.
* Proven project management skills, with experience keeping projects on schedule, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.
* Strong client\-facing experience, including hosting meetings, providing training, and presenting technical concepts in an accessible way.
* Track record of driving client satisfaction, including gathering feedback, addressing concerns, and generating positive client reviews or testimonials.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate across internal teams and manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

\-\-

**What You’re Obsessed With:**

* HubSpot mastery, staying up to date on features and best practices.
* Helping clients succeed and feel confident with new tools.
* Making complex software simple and understandable.
* Keeping projects organized, on time, and within scope.
* Providing clear, actionable guidance that drives results.
* Gathering feedback and turning it into positive client experiences.
* Collaborating with internal teams to deliver seamless onboarding.
* Seeing measurable impact from your work through client satisfaction and success.

\-\-

**A Day in the Life…**

Your day starts with reviewing ongoing client onboarding projects, checking progress, and ensuring everything is on track and within scope. You lead client meetings to provide training, share best practices, and offer setup guidance, helping clients feel confident using HubSpot’s Marketing, Sales, or Service Hub.

Throughout the day, you collaborate closely with the production team, making sure your recommendations are implemented smoothly, and coordinate with other internal teams to resolve any questions or challenges. You track project milestones, monitor client satisfaction, and gather feedback to ensure successful onboarding and generate positive reviews.

Your role is all about delivering exceptional client experiences, keeping projects on schedule, and helping clients get the most value from HubSpot.

\-\-

**Interview Process** 

1\. Introductory Chat (15 minutes)

2\. HubSpot Demo \& Team Interview (45–60 minutes)

3\. Reference Check \& Offer

\-\-

**The Future of Freelancing is Fractional** 

* Complete flexibility in when you work. No required hours or fixed schedule.
* Autonomy to manage your time in a way that fits your life and working style.
* Clear project\-based hour allocations that allow you to plan and prioritize with confidence.
* High\-trust environment with plenty of tools and resources to empower you to achieve successful outcomes.
* Client work is provided 100% post\-sale; no pitching, selling, or business development required.
* Remain an active member of our team between project assignments.
* Ability to focus on your craft and deliver great work without worrying about finding the next engagement.
* Collaborative team support without the constraints of a traditional full\-time role.
* A culture of teamwork and recognition that brings together diverse talent in a fun environment.

Pay: $50\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* The primary responsibilities of this role are hosting client meetings, providing customer service through email, and training clients on HubSpot tools. Does this align with your goals?
* What systems have you integrated with HubSpot, if any?

Experience:

* HubSpot: 5 years (Required)
* Marketing agency: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Remote Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Remote Revenue Operations Specialist**
----------------------------------------


**Location:** Remote — United States  

**Department:** Revenue / Sales Operations  

**Reports To:** Revenue Operations / Sales Leadership  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**Salary:** $65,000–$85,000 per year


**About PMWEB**
---------------


PMWEB is an enterprise software company specializing in construction technology (ConTech) and capital project management. Our platform helps organizations plan, manage, and control complex capital projects and programs across industries including aviation, healthcare, infrastructure, financial services, higher education, real estate, and more.


As PMWEB continues to expand its enterprise software business, we are looking for a Revenue Operations Specialist to help build efficient, data\-driven processes across Sales, Marketing, and Revenue teams.


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


The Revenue Operations Specialist will help PMWEB improve the systems, processes, data, and reporting that support revenue growth.


This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, highly organized, technology\-oriented, and enjoys turning data and processes into practical improvements. You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, and leadership to maintain accurate CRM data, improve sales processes, monitor performance, and provide insights that help the organization make better decisions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Manage and maintain revenue and sales operations processes across the organization.
* Administer and maintain CRM systems, ensuring accurate account, contact, opportunity, and activity data.
* Monitor CRM data quality, identify inconsistencies, and implement improvements.
* Build and maintain sales and revenue reports, dashboards, and performance tracking.
* Support pipeline management, forecasting, territory management, and sales reporting.
* Track key revenue metrics including pipeline creation, conversion rates, sales activity, win rates, and revenue performance.
* Support the Business Development and Account Executive teams with lead routing, account assignments, prospect data, and sales processes.
* Manage and improve lead lifecycle and lead qualification processes.
* Assist with sales forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation or workflow improvements.
* Support sales compensation and commission reporting as needed.
* Coordinate with Marketing on lead generation, campaign tracking, attribution, and lead handoffs.
* Help establish standardized processes and documentation for the Revenue organization.
* Conduct data analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and potential issues within the sales pipeline.
* Support CRM integrations, sales tools, and other revenue technology platforms.
* Prepare recurring reports and presentations for sales leadership and management.
* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership on revenue\-related projects.
* Assist with the implementation of new tools, workflows, and operational initiatives.


**Qualifications**
------------------


### **Required**


* 1\+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical role.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with CRM systems and sales data.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.


### **Preferred**


* Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience with sales automation and revenue technology tools.
* Experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software.
* Experience supporting an enterprise sales organization.
* Familiarity with sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM reporting.
* Experience with BI/reporting tools.
* Experience in construction technology, project management software, real estate technology, or another B2B technology environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.


**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------


Success in this role may be measured by:


* CRM data accuracy and completeness
* Pipeline reporting accuracy
* Forecasting support and reliability
* Revenue reporting quality
* Lead routing and conversion efficiency
* Sales\-process efficiency
* Timeliness of reporting
* Adoption of revenue tools and processes
* Successful implementation of operational improvements
* Contribution to overall revenue\-team efficiency


**What PMWEB Offers**
---------------------


* **$65,000–$85,000 annual salary**
* Remote work within the United States
* Medical and dental benefits
* 401(k)
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Exposure to enterprise software and major capital projects
* Opportunity to work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and company leadership
* Career growth within a growing enterprise software organization


**Career Growth**
-----------------


This role can provide a path toward positions such as:


**Revenue Operations Specialist Senior Revenue Operations Specialist Revenue Operations Manager Director of Revenue Operations**


Additional opportunities may include Sales Operations, Business Operations, Sales Strategy, or GTM Operations.


**Why Join PMWEB?**
-------------------


PMWEB sits at the intersection of **enterprise software, construction technology, and capital project management**. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in building the systems and processes behind a growing B2B software business while working with teams serving organizations managing complex, high\-value projects.

* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of NPI roadmaps, EOL schedules, cut\-over decisions, scope/BOM handoffs, and lifecycle\-management decisions, ensuring a clear system of record as hardware generations turn over.
* **Problem Solving:** Identify and resolve complex planning challenges where new hardware requirements outpace existing site capabilities, or where cut\-over timing is at risk, escalating trade\-offs that affect delivery timelines.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

Uses skills as a seasoned and experienced administrative operations professional to manage, plan, and administer operational and facilities functions for the Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI), spanning several locations. Provides day\-to\-day operational coordination for CNEI, ensuring consistent standards, procedures, and working conditions across multiple CNEI locations. Demonstrates good judgment in independently coordinating operational and administrative processes and prioritizing multi\-site logistics.


**Department Overview**

The Center for Nursing Excellence \& Innovation (CNEI) is a support department with five main divisions: Nursing Professional Development, Nursing Quality and Analytics, Clinical Practice, Nursing Continuous Improvement and Research, and Magnet Recognition Program®. The Professional Development team includes Nursing Professional Development Specialists who oversee the Department of Nursing’s training and education needs. The Nursing Practice team includes Clinical Nurse Specialists and Advanced Practice Specialists, who oversee evidence\-based practice standards that optimize quality and safety patient outcomes. The Research \& Scholarship team includes Nurse Scientists and a Scholarship Development Specialist who oversee the infrastructure for clinical inquiry, research, and innovation. The Nursing Continuous Improvement team oversees continuous improvement and evidence\-based practice processes across the system. The Nursing Quality and Analytics team includes nursing quality analysts who oversee data production, dissemination, and analytics. The Magnet Program Director collaborates with CNEI, Nursing leaders, and the Nursing Department to advance excellence in accordance with Magnet Recognition Program® standards. The mission of the CNEI team is to prepare and support UCSF nurses to be expert clinicians and authentic leaders who provide high\-quality, compassionate care, foster the spirit of clinical inquiry, promote professional development, and enhance a culture of diversity and inclusivity.


  
**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 3 years of administrative operations or facilities coordination experience.
* Thorough knowledge of University rules and regulations, processes, protocols and procedures for facilities and logistics.
* Interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, active listening, critical thinking, persuasiveness, advising and counseling skills.
* Knowledge of a variety of administrative operational activities such as supply purchasing, expense tracking, event planning, inventory, equipment, and facilities record keeping.
  

Solid knowledge of common University\-specific computer application programs (Office 365, Drupal, ServiceNow).
* Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Strong skills in short\-term planning, analysis, problem\-solving, and customer service.
* Strong customer service orientation across all locations and able to run operations on competing site\-level priorities.
* Ability to coordinate and prioritize work across multiple locations with minimal supervision.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of workplace safety regulations and experience serving as site safety coordinator or liaison.
* Project management certification from a reputable organization such as PMP, CSM, or ACP to include a qualifying exam and/or quality assurance processes like Six Sigma or Lean or equivalent project management experience.

Coordinates and monitors operations of ambulatory care clinics in conjunction with Nurse Manager and Medical Directors. Implements projects of large scope and high degrees of complexity. The Clinical Operations Specialist analyzes and determines clinical coverage needs of Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion Hospital Operating Rooms, the Orthopedic Institute, and all off\-site Anesthesia sites, in both operating and non\-operating locations. This individual then analyzes staffing availability data and develops staffing of more than 298 Anesthesiologists. This requires coordination with individuals charged with CRNA and clinical residents.
The Clinical Operations Specialist analyzes and determines clinical coverage needs of Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion Hospital Operating Rooms, the Orthopedic Institute, and all off\-site Anesthesia sites, in both operating and non\-operating locations. This individual then analyzes staffing availability data and develops staffing of more than 298 Anesthesiologists. This requires coordination with individuals charged with CRNA and clinical residents. This position must ensure appropriate coverage is provided for several specialty services, in addition to the operating rooms. Any staffing deficiencies or inappropriate coverage may pose risks to patient safety and affect the department’s operating costs. The position is responsible for identifying, analyzing and resolving staffing conflicts; moreover, the Clinical Operations Specialist is responsible for providing notice to principals (faculty, managers and staff) regarding amendments and modifications. The Clinial Operations Specialist must ensure the faculty are scheduled accordingly to their clinical requirements as established by their annual contracts. This has direct impact to the individual’s clinical incentive compensation and the Department’s operating costs.
  

  

The Clinical Operations Specialist assesses, identifies, and implements process improvements and AI or other automation opportunities for the clinical operations workflows within their scope of work. This may include, but is not limited to, new technology solutions and the creation and implementation of AI and machine learning\-enabled care workflows, in partnership and close collaboration with clinical and administrative professionals within the Anesthesia Department and across other parts of the UCSF enterprise.
  

  

The Clinical Operations Specialist will report directly to the Director of Clinical Operations with close working partnerships with the Vice Chairs of the Department of Anesthesia.
**Department Description:**The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care at UCSF provides outstanding patient care, promotes cutting\-edge basic and clinical science research, and educates the next generation of health care providers while focusing on the principles of community.
  

  

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care ranks as one of the largest departments in the School of Medicine with an annual budget of $145 million. The two largest components of the annual budget are Professional Fee Income and Extramural Funds, representing 90\.4% or $132 million (including ZSFG professional fees and 6\.9% or $10\.1 million of the annual budget respectively. Currently, the department has over 298 Faculty members, 27 Staff Physicians, 205 Staff Employees, 6 Fellows, 90 Residents, 12 Non\-Faculty Academics, 11 postdocs, 68 CRNAs, and 5 Nurse Practitioners at ZSFG.
  

  

In addition to the Moffitt\-Long Hospital, very active units of the department exist at the Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (inpatient and outpatient, including a very active trauma service), San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center (inpatient and outpatient), Mt. Zion Medical Center (outpatient, including 23\-hour stays and the Pain Management Center), Benioff Children's Hospital Oakland, the UCSF Orthopedic Institute and the Benioff Children's, Betty Irene Moore Women's and Bakar Cancer (NIH\-designated Cancer Center) Hospitals in the Mission Bay neighborhood.
  

  

The Department now has essential roles in patient care outside of the operating rooms, with active participation in Ambulatory Care, Acute and Chronic Pain, and in the Preoperative Clinic. Over the department’s fifty\-plus years of existence, the department has been at the heart of modern anesthesia’s explosive growth, and to this day, continues to have an enormous impact on surgical practice and the management of pain. The department’s research, education, and clinical care quickly earned and maintained reputations that are equal to or better than any institution in the world. Individual members of our faculty have had a major influence on our specialty both nationally and internationally, including NIH study sections, NIH funding, FDA, and Editorial Boards. Research activities within this department are integrated with and inform clinical practice. For many years, ours has been among the top departments for NIH research funding in anesthesia in the United States.
  

  

The Department of Anesthesia provides considerable support and structure for research in general and, for research training programs, highlighted by the innovative Pathway to Scientific Independence (PSI). This program begins at the residency level, incorporating the Research Scholars Track of the Anesthesia Residency, moving through the post\-residency NIH\-funded T32 training grant and faculty positions with mentored research support, and ultimately achieving extramurally funded, independent researcher status.

**Overview**

A private equity\-backed veterinary healthcare platform is seeking an experienced veterinary executive to lead the buildout, acquisition, and operational oversight of a national network of large animal specialty and emergency hospitals. The Managing Director / Platform President will be responsible for identifying acquisition opportunities, developing new greenfield hospital locations, integrating acquired practices, and building a scalable multi\-site veterinary platform. **Platform Development \& M\&A**

* Identify and evaluate acquisition targets including specialty and emergency large animal hospitals across strategic markets
* Lead sourcing, diligence, and integration of veterinary practice acquisitions in partnership with private equity investment teams
* Develop greenfield opportunities, including market selection, site development, hospital design, and launch planning
* Build a scalable regional and national veterinary hospital platform through acquisitions and organic development

* Monitor financial performance, operational KPIs, and growth metrics across the network

* Experience managing multi\-site veterinary hospitals or specialty veterinary practices
